systems.system: Sistema digital para emissão do DUAT
systems.owner: Ministério da Agricultura, Ambiente e Pescas

note: The ministry only says it will create a digital DUAT issuance system this term; no work under way or in service is stated.
Document states nothing this study asks for Mozambique.

facts.fact: The World Bank IEG review says the land information system SIGIT was upgraded, operational and available when the project closed, and that 1,283,171 DUATs were recorded in it.
The World Bank IEG review says SIGIT included a web portal that enabled public access to the national cadastre land data.

note: Only the tax register is mentioned, not a land register.
The document states nothing this study asks.
Only a municipal land property request service on the citizen portal, being added and from a discontinued portal version; no land register stated.
A digital land-title issuance system is only announced for the current five-year term; nothing under way or in service stated.

facts.fact: Partners for Water reports that in Beira, 20 local staff were trained to scan and register 40,000 plots into a new database holding all land and property data.
Jornal Ikweli reports Nampula municipality began a property cadastre in February 2025 and had registered 44,706 properties by May 2025.

The MCC evaluation brief says most land offices have significant challenges in land record management and many rely on paper records because the land information system is not functioning or is only a back-up database.

note: Document does not mention the land register.
